name: template-app-ui
description: TEMPLATE — mode-agnostic frontend for aw-app-template (ADR Decision 3/4/6, docs/knowledge_base/docs/architecture/adr-app-front-back-routes-dual-mode.md). src/client.js is the framework-free core; src/plugin.js is the integrated-mode entry (register(host), built as a Vite lib-mode bundle); src/standalone.js + index.html is the standalone page. `npm run build` produces ui/dist/, consumed by BOTH __main__.py (standalone) and aw-app.json's contributes.frontend.bundle (integrated).

scripts.build: npm run build:plugin && npm run build:standalone
